development_path_review.method: Read-only inspection of the cited primary logs, protocols, receipts and estimator source. Hash comparisons used bytes only. No estimator was imported or executed and neither repository was modified.

coverage_notes: All nine mining slices received a second audit for actual programs and local dependencies.
Every experiment code directory contains Python or shell programs under code/, with relative source layout preserved.
Eleven measured-result records have no recovered exact execution program and remain outside the experiment code directories.
Four verified wrong result/judge associations were corrected from original receipts.
The original Phase 2 map preserves its source metadata and recorded statuses; one search also includes all August–October research records.

Main node links open existing work directories. Of 642 original research nodes, 621 have folders of directly cited files; 21 explicitly report no recovered direct work folder. Exact source JSON remains available under Technical details.

The integrated canvas contains 642 original research nodes and 34 development/build records. Seven source-backed display-parent changes join concrete early estimator implementations to the later development. Both final paths run through the analytic baseline, cumulant state, learned correction, rebuilt core, subsequent retained changes and shared final fit. All source objects and 791 scientific edges are preserved. No detached release cluster or dotted method associations remain.

The opening panel explains the problem and offers six approaches. Estimator development follows 35 shared milestones and then branches to both designated variants, with failed alternatives alongside. All 642 research nodes have concise explanations and the 641 nonroot nodes have recorded results; source evidence and work-folder links remain available. Selection preserves the complete surrounding graph and its current node positions.
Publication-edited memory notes preserve independent research content; provenance records released bytes separately from original-source bytes.
limitations: Live browser rendering could not be tested because the browser-control service failed to start. All 648 solid routes were checked against unrelated node boxes, 185 interactions executed against the embedded HTML in jsdom, and the overview, core-rebuild and parallel-final-variant SVG renders were inspected.
The locally executed estimators exceeded the hosted residual-time cap; the tests establish numerical execution and one-network public scoring with relaxed timing gates.
Historical research scripts retain original machine paths and data assumptions. Code availability does not imply every old numerical run is turnkey.
Exact artifact reconstruction uses fitted coefficients. Complete retraining requires large assets that remain unpublished or were not recovered; see data/DATA_INDEX.md.
Private re-evaluation scores are not inferred from archived public or local one-network results.

The development path is a source-backed selection of milestones, not every intermediate version or a globally shortest research route. The independent core rebuild is explicit; other edges distinguish summarized development from exact source parents. The final coefficient exports and assembly from #337506 are verified by hashes.

publication.scope: Git release with the self-contained research graph and paper on gh-pages; repository visibility is managed separately.
